description: Returns the signed-in person's saved email signature as html and text, with their sender details as fields in sender, for appending to an email they want signed. Append it after the body, in place of a sign-off of your own. For the sender's own details anywhere in the email (name, title, phone, email, links), use only the values in sender; if one is missing, leave it out and say so - never guess. mode "short": name, role line and one link. signature: "me" (default), or an AI assistant or company AI agent from list_signatures; if it is unclear which this email needs, ask before sending. To change the signature, use update_my_signature. Parts the company controls are listed in companyControlled, with who changes them in howToChange; tell the person.

signature.description: "me" (default), or an agent's id or name from list_signatures.

name: get_signature
title: Get my saved signature
